facts.fact: Insights is available only on Business and Enterprise plans.
Access to Insights is limited to workspace admins and owners.
According to Lovable's documentation, Insights does not consume credits, whether a user views it or exports its data.
facts.quote: Insights does not consume credits, whether you view it or export its data.

facts.fact: Lovable's Insights metric cards cover the last 30 days and show the percentage change from the 30 days before.
facts.quote: Each number covers the last 30 days. Next to it, Lovable shows the percentage change from the 30 days before

facts.fact: Per Lovable's documentation, an App visit is one person opening a published app, and a return visit, reload, or new tab each counts as another visit, so visits are not unique people.
facts.quote: A **visit** is one person opening a published app. The same person returning later counts as another visit, and so does a reload or a new tab, so visits do not count unique people.

facts.fact: Per Lovable's documentation, only published apps can have visits.
facts.quote: Only published apps can have visits.

facts.fact: Per Lovable's documentation, Active builders counts only workspace members who built something in the last 30 days, while the builders list shows every member.
facts.quote: **Active builders** counts only the members who built something in the last 30 days.

facts.fact: Per Lovable's documentation, Active apps (30d) counts apps with any activity in the last 30 days, whether published or not.
facts.quote: Apps with any activity in the last 30 days, published or not

facts.fact: Per Lovable's documentation, Insights counts app and chat connections, including custom connectors, but does not count chat connectors (MCP servers) or app user connections.
facts.quote: It does not count [chat connectors](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/custom-mcp) (MCP servers) or [app user connections]

facts.fact: Per Lovable's documentation, the example given is that one person visiting on two days counts as two visits in App visits (30d).
facts.quote: One person visiting on two days counts as two visits. This is not a count of unique people.
